answer: A beacon-backed consensus layer links equivocation proofs across bonded identities, so splitting one operator into k sybils does not divide liability: correlated violations incur aggregate penalties proportional to k². Escrowed collateral depreciates asymmetrically, and detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the coordinated swarm, making extra identities amplify rather than dilute risk. A wharf ledger records each jade-tagged bond for auditable attribution.
